reviews.title: The App is Broken
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for years and it’s been good but now it won’t do anything other than view just the front page.
Unable to view any MOT history, the app just freezes not allowing me to scroll or do anything. I’ve deleted and reinstalled but nothing changes. 
It’s now completely useless and NOT fit for purpose.

reviews.title: Avoid Hacking App ratings Beware!
reviews.text: Avoid. The car check gave incorrect information and could easily mislead someone. Support was rude when I asked for help and they wouldn’t refund me. Waste of money. I don’t know  how they do it, but they cheat the rating system. Apple they should be banned  for hacking ratings! They reward users for ratings! They should be BANNED from App Store!!

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Scam app. U pay way too much for an advanced check around £12. And u can only view the card details one time only even though you’ve paid. Once u get off the app and go back on u cannot check the cars history again even though you’ve paid. Waste of money. Scam app

reviews.text: Horrible app reviews requests all the time on opening. Received a developer response which blames Apple for the issue although no other app has this problem

reviews.title: Looses Purchases and won’t update
reviews.text: This use to be good but now looses your purchases and tells you to goto your App Store purchases to get the a code to restore. In the App Store there is nothing to say which purchase matches the vehicle saved. Suppose that’s the problem once someone pays for the details they won’t spend any more money on the app

reviews.title: MOT reminder bug
reviews.text: My car passed the MOT three weeks before its annual MOT date, but annoyingly I still receive regular reminders that my MOT is going to expire. Definitely need to fix this bug!!!

reviews.title: Garage
reviews.text:
Used to be able to have my 4 vehicles in the garage but now only 3!! 
Why the change?

reviews.title: Lost all my purchases
reviews.text: Every purchase I made in this app has disappeared. There’s an option to restore purchase but I need to find the specific order number for each once, instead of just linking my apple account and restoring them all. Also I can’t find any way to restore salvage data purchases

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
This app is trying to get me to pay for my rad tax that expires in 32 days.
By doing this I would loose a full month of road tax.!!!!!!!!!!!!!
AND it makes it look like that your road tax is due and you need to pay now for it.

reviews.title: Difficult to find MOT Info
reviews.text:
This app has become so difficult to find MOT section! It’s gradually got worse and worse and now it’s almost impossible to!

Update for developer:- when I refresh my garage and click a vehicle there is no MOT history button or tab. The only way to find MOT info is to click MY Notes then you can see MOT history which is not how it used to be. This interface is complicated and unnecessary. When I click My Garage and then click a vehicle it should have the MOT button on there so it’s simple rather than the 9 buttons for things I don’t need.

reviews.title: For every feature you need to pay a subscription
reviews.text: With every year they are becoming more and more greedy and for every feature is asking you for premium subscription £8 per year or £35 for a lifetime. The greedy developers should be ashamed of themselves.
